LanguageData.MBBS_MoreTip: Buttons collapsed into the drawer. The drawer has its own settings button at the bottom.
LanguageData.MBBS_ModSettings_InGame: Opened in a game: changes apply to the current save.
LanguageData.MBBS_ModSettings_MainMenu: Opened from the main menu: changes apply to the default template that new games start with.
LanguageData.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBar: Always draw the bar with this mod (for testing)
LanguageData.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBarTip: Until you change something, the game keeps drawing the bar itself. Turn this on to compare this mod's drawing with the game's.
LanguageData.MBBS_OriginallyHiddenTip: Buttons their mod keeps off the bar on purpose. Turn on "Always show" in Advanced to put one on the bar.
LanguageData.MBBS_OrderHint: Top to bottom = left to right on screen. Drag rows to reorder.
LanguageData.MBBS_NotShowingNowTip: Not on the bar right now: the button's own condition is not met.
LanguageData.MBBS_Mode_Vanilla_Desc: Like the base game: the screen width is shared equally. No scrolling and no drawer.
LanguageData.MBBS_Mode_Collapse_Desc: Buttons marked "Drawer" move into the More drawer; the rest share the bar.
LanguageData.MBBS_Mode_Scroll_Desc: Buttons keep their width; scroll the bar with the mouse wheel or the arrows. The drawer is not used.
LanguageData.MBBS_Mode_CollapseScroll_Desc: Drawer as in Collapse; the remaining buttons scroll.
LanguageData.MBBS_FillScreenTip: When the buttons fit, stretch them to use the whole width.
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLocked: Lock the game menu button at the right end
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLockedTip: While locked, the menu button cannot be hidden, moved or put in the drawer; it can only be renamed.
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuUnlockedNote: The game menu button has been unlocked in Advanced.
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLockedNote: The game menu button is locked at the right end and can only be renamed. Unlock it in Advanced, on the whole bar row.
LanguageData.MBBS_Info_OriginallyHidden: Its mod keeps it off the bar on purpose; it appears only with "Always show".
LanguageData.MBBS_ButtonWidthFollow: Width: same as the whole bar
LanguageData.MBBS_ForceShowTip: Show the button even when its own condition says it should not appear. Clicking it may then do nothing.
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyReadOnly: Hotkey: {0} (editing comes in a later version)
LanguageData.MBBS_TemplateSaved: Saved as the default template. New games will start with this arrangement.
LanguageData.MBBS_ResetAllConfirm: Reset every setting to the untouched bar (the game plus what other mods changed)? This does not apply the template.
